name: traderspy
description: Live crypto futures data for your agent: AI trading signals, whale positions across Binance, Hyperliquid, Bybit and OKX, 19 technical indicators, funding and open interest, a market screener and a backtester. Read-only — no order, transfer or withdrawal tools.

TRADERSPY_API_KEY.title: TraderSpy API key
